_comment: Tier-2 for skfem mixed_poisson#4 (previously 'claim inherited -- not yet empirically separated'). Measured on skfem 12.0.1 with the dual mixed RT0/P0 system on MeshTri().refined(3): leaving the outflow facet DOFs free lets the boundary flux settle at whatever the interior dictates, an O(1) deviation from any prescribed value; constraining those DOFs reproduces the prescribed flux to machine precision. NOTE the claim describes the flux trace as the NATURAL condition imposed by a test-side boundary integral -- in the dual mixed form implemented here it is the ESSENTIAL one (constrained RT0 DOFs) while the pressure/Dirichlet datum is the natural one. The observable in the claim's Signal reproduces either way and is what this fixture pins.
